description: Response to POST /race/validate: the race's advantage-point balance and whether it is a legal design.
title: RaceValidateResponse

advantage-points.description: Leftover advantage points. A legal race has a value >= 0; the race wizard shows this as the live point counter.

valid.description: True when the race is legal (advantage-points >= 0).

failure-reason.description: Human-readable reason the race is invalid. Present only when valid is false.
